strengths.text: Strong solar generation and modular surface infrastructure.

weaknesses.text: The initial settlement footprint is spread too widely.

opportunities.text: Modular construction can scale into a genuine town.

threats.text: Dust storms could isolate critical modules from one another.

responses.critical-risk: Essential systems are distributed across exposed modules without protected connecting routes.

risk-position.rationale: High scientific and social value, with engineering risks that can be reduced through a more compact first phase.

responses.crew-policy: Give residents an elected council with authority over schedules, shared spaces, and non-emergency mission rules.
responses.required-change: Build shielded tunnels between all life-critical modules before crew arrival.
